name: Reffelt Constant v2 benchmark

readings.elite: freedom M_d = 1 - mean ||F(pi_d(i+1)) - F(pi_d(i))|| / mean ||F_a - F_b|| over the retained-mode embedding F = D^-1/2 psi; importance w_d proportional to 1/max(M_d, s0), s0 = sd/mean of pair distances / sqrt(n-1)
readings.unbiased: w_d proportional to max(xi(x_d -> graph low-pass of score), 0)

digit_rule: r_d = D * w_d; digit 0 (freeze candidate) if r_d < 1, else min(9, 5 + floor(log2 r_d))
